note: Every pair converts the two fixture recordings with taskrecorder_to_markdown (`@b64:<path>` is expanded by the runner to the file's base64). r[0] = taskrec-sample.axtr (A), r[1] = test.axtr (B); each structuredContent is {markdown, file_name}. `expr` parses the markdown and must evaluate to the <answer> string.

pairs.title: Total user actions across A and B
pairs.expr: r.map(x => +/\*\*Total User Actions\*\* \| (\d+)/.exec(x.markdown)[1]).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0)

pairs.title: Form visited in B but not in A
pairs.expr: (forms => forms(r[1]).filter(n => !forms(r[0]).includes(n)).join(','))(x => [...x.markdown.split('## Forms Visited')[1].split('## Recorded Steps')[0].matchAll(/\| \d+ \| `(\w+)`/g)].map(m => m[1]))

pairs.title: Which recording navigates, and to which menu item
Data-source tables: B minus A
pairs.expr: (ds => ds(r[1]) - ds(r[0]))(x => x.markdown.split('## Data Sources')[1].split('## Security Roles')[0].split('\n').filter(l => /^\| `/.test(l)).reduce((n, l) => n + (l.split('|')[2].match(/`[^`]+`/g) || []).length, 0))

pairs.title: Null-control recording and the other's hyperlink control
Distinct command action types across both
Distinct privileges in both BPM role tables
pairs.expr: new Set(r.flatMap(x => x.markdown.split('## Security Roles')[1].split('## Scope Tree')[0].split('\n').filter(l => /^\| /.test(l) && !/^\| Role|^\| ---/.test(l)).map(l => /`([^`]+)`/.exec(l.split('|')[3])[1]))).size

pairs.title: Full-control privilege in A, Full-control rows in B
pairs.expr: (rows => [...new Set(rows(r[0]).filter(l => /Full control/.test(l)).map(l => /`([^`]+)`/.exec(l.split('|')[3])[1]))].join('+') + ',' + rows(r[1]).filter(l => /Full control/.test(l)).length)(x => x.markdown.split('## Security Roles')[1].split('## Scope Tree')[0].split('\n').filter(l => /^\| /.test(l) && !/^\| Role|^\| ---/.test(l)))

pairs.title: Same recording name? Same canonical ID?
pairs.expr: (g => (g(r[0], 'Recording Name') === g(r[1], 'Recording Name') ? 'True' : 'False') + ',' + (g(r[0], 'Canonical ID') === g(r[1], 'Canonical ID') ? 'True' : 'False'))((x, k) => new RegExp('\\*\\*' + k + '\\*\\* \\| `?([^|`]+)').exec(x.markdown)[1].trim())

pairs.title: The one list/grid-context step
pairs.expr: (hits => hits.length === 1 ? hits[0].file_name + ',' + /### Step (\d+)\n[^#]*?List\/Grid Context:\*\* (\w+)/.exec(hits[0].markdown).slice(1).join(',') : 'not unique')(r.filter(x => x.markdown.includes('List/Grid Context')))
